notes: repo-522 dufs: NOT_COMPATIBLE judged from README Docker usage mounting /data (local disk state); image runs without a mount but serves nothing useful. Could be READY.

repo-523 dawarich: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION; Dockerfile has ENTRYPOINT bundle exec and no CMD, storage defaults to local Disk (S3 via env), needs PostGIS extension on Postgres (unverified on RDS flow). Workers from Procfile sidekiq.
repo-524 microblog: READY; Elasticsearch is optional (not labelled unsupported); no health route so healthPath omitted; sqlite fallback only when DATABASE_URL unset.
repo-525 komga: NOT_COMPATIBLE (SQLite in /config volume, media mount). Runtime label "java" is a guess for Kotlin/JVM; dockerfilePath omitted because only Dockerfile.tpl (template) exists.

repo-526 nopCommerce: NOT_COMPATIBLE (install wizard writes App_Data/dataSettings.json, local uploads). postgres true because Postgres is a supported provider but SQL Server is the default; uncertain. No health route found.

repo-527 parse-server: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION with postgres true; default store is MongoDB and mongodb is a hard dependency, so an alternative label is NOT_COMPATIBLE with unsupported mongodb. Health path assumes default mountPath /parse.

repo-528 electric: NOT_COMPATIBLE (needs wal_level=logical, file storage by default, Dockerfile needs named build context electric-telemetry). dockerfilePath given repo-root relative; convention unclear. MEMORY storage option exists.

repo-529 snipe-it: NOT_COMPATIBLE with unsupported mysql (image has only pdo_mysql, upload volume). Reading of mysql as unsupported follows the UNSUPPORTED_FAMILIES map though mvp-scope.md lists RDS MySQL 8.0.
repo-530 asynqmon: READY; Redis required; no Dockerfile EXPOSE, port 8080 from PORT default; no dedicated health route found.
